note: Triennial election of Down County Council. There was no contest: one person was nominated for each of the 20 electoral divisions, so all were returned unopposed and no poll was held (Belfast News-Letter, 18 May 1949). Party labels are not printed in the list and none are given. Addresses and occupations printed with the names are not reproduced (privacy rule; gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
